comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve the verify:full label wakeup**

When `verify:full` is applied to an already-open PR, removing `labeled` means this workflow no longer starts, while the repository-wide search shows its only Gate integration is the `force-full` expression below. Consequently, a docs-only or otherwise narrowly classified PR retains its prior reduced Gate result and does not run the full Python/integration jobs until an unrelated synchronize, reopen, or manual-dispatch event occurs; retain a targeted wakeup for this label while suppressing restarts from unrelated labels.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
